claims.property: Runtime emits one-second liveness heartbeat and fails closed on bounded timeout.
claims.acceptance: Selftest proves heartbeat policy and timeout->HOLD with blind_retry=false.

claims.property: Metacognitive self-audit cannot self-grant G23 or G24.
claims.acceptance: Self-audit record retains g23_granted=false and g24_granted=false and escalates human/source conflicts.

excluded_claims: Academic correctness or originality of any future report.
Human fluency or technical mastery in a video.
Bit-for-bit output reproducibility across arbitrary environments.
Audiovisual validation until FFprobe provider is pinned and admitted.
Certification of future task profiles merely because the framework is certified.
